title: How do I make the train wheels/tracks move?

posts.author: Blackeyychann
posts.body:
I tried my best to google answers for a few good hours now but i can't seem to find any help. So here i am. If this is the wrong thread then please feel free to let me know or move it. I recently bought the add on volume 3 for RPG Maker MV. Which includes the train tileset. I've seen videos of people having the same set and their wheels move along with the tracks it seems. I may be wrong but something is animated and i can't for the life of me figure it out. Below is a picture of what I have. I just want the wheels to seem like it's moving. I also can't seem to figure out the smoking chimney either. Any help would be greatly appreciated.
( I tried to make events to see if i can rotate the wheels to act like its moving but that's not working either )

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
I haven't got the tileset myself but where water/lava/poison tiles would go (animated ones) it would be those there that would make the wheels move.
Assuming the tileset was built with A1 in mind.
Otherwise it would be an event. Check your characters and see if you can find the wheels there.

posts.author: Sodium89
posts.body: Maybe the wheels should be events and not tiles. That way you can animate them to appear like they're spinning.

While they are "animated", it looks like whoever did it just flipped the wheels. That's easily done tbh. Cut out the wheels with like gimp, put it on a character sheet, flip the image back and forth, put as events, turn on stepping, done.
Now if you want something better looking, you'll need to be a little more skilled in the image editing department.
